releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Plan Ahead can now save fixed days, such as the gym on set days, with hours for each day.

releases.title: A clearer way to plan your week
changes: Set weekly hours right from Life. Tap an area in the time strip to adjust its hours.
Plan Ahead lets you move hours into future weeks after reviewing the change.
The Week screen has a smaller task inbox and a clearer way to browse weeks.
Mark important tasks with a red exclamation point.
Create areas with Add Life and find fewer duplicate controls in More.
